objects.name: $133 million stolen from French bank via exploited service provider
objects.description: The French cooperative banking group, which has €211.5 billion in total assets and more than 5.8 million customers, confirmed the attack days after blockchain investigator ZachXBT began tracking over $100 million in suspected stolen funds moving out of centralized exchange accounts.
